criteria.criterion: Use the correct Oyez case page (Brown v. Board of Education of Topeka (1), not Brown II)
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent sourced information from the specified Oyez page for Brown v. Full credit if the agent uses the Brown I page or, if Oyez is inaccessible/blocked, the agent explicitly states it could not access/verify the Brown I page and therefore cannot reliably extract the requested fields. Partial credit if the agent appears to use Oyez but the case version is ambiguous. No credit if the agent clearly uses Brown II or non-Oyez sources in place of the specified page when the Brown I page is accessible.

criteria.criterion: Report all required dates with argued vs. reargued ranges kept distinct
criteria.description: Verify the agent reported (a) argued dates, (b) reargued dates, and (c) decided date from the Brown I Oyez page, keeping argued and reargued ranges distinct. Full credit if all three are present and clearly separated, OR if the agent states the page/dates were inaccessible or did not render despite an attempt. Partial credit if one date field is missing or argued/reargued are present but not clearly distinguished. No credit if dates are wrong/merged with no stated access/rendering limitation.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows ARGUED “Dec 9 – 11, 1952”. Screenshot 2 (later state) shows REARGUED “Dec 7 - 9, 1953” and DECIDED “May 17, 1954.”
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: All required dates are visible across the screenshots and the agent’s output matches them, with argued vs reargued kept distinct. Keep full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows an “ARGUED” label with dates “Dec 9 – 11, 1952”. A “REARGUED” label is visible but the actual reargued dates are cut off below the fold and not readable in this screenshot. No “DECIDED” date is visible in this screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Only the argued date range is verifiable from the screenshot. The agent’s predicted output includes reargued dates (“December 7–9, 1953”) and decided date (“May 17, 1954”), but those are not visible here, so this screenshot cannot substantiate them. Based strictly on screenshot evidence, the criterion is only partially supported (argued dates confirmed; reargued/decided not confirmable from this image).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent claims specific reargued and decided dates, but this screenshot does not display them (reargued dates are not visible; decided date not shown). The screenshot does not contradict the agent’s dates; it simply provides no visual support for those two fields.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot clearly shows: under "REARGUED" the date range "Dec 7 - 9, 1953"; under "DECIDED" the date "May 17, 1954". The argued dates section is not visible in the screenshot (only reargued and decided are shown in the left-center column).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms reargued dates and decided date, but does not show the argued date range. The agent’s predicted output includes argued dates ("December 9–11, 1952"), reargued dates ("December 7–9, 1953"), and decided date ("May 17, 1954") and keeps them distinct. Only two of those (reargued and decided) can be verified from this screenshot; argued dates are unsupported by the visible evidence. As a result, based strictly on the screenshot, this is partial confirmation.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent claims argued dates are Dec 9–11, 1952, but the screenshot does not display any "Argued" label or the 1952 range—so that portion is not verifiable from this image. The reargued and decided dates in the predicted output match what is visible (Dec 7–9, 1953; May 17, 1954).
